data.situation:
On Friday, Lin took her draft to the tutor's desk. There were only two pages, but she had read them so often that she no longer noticed their gaps. The tutor began with the assessment criteria: a clear question, relevant evidence and an explanation of how the evidence supported the answer. He put the criteria beside the draft rather than hiding them until the end. Feedback on your draft
The question is clear. Your assessment of the photograph is careful, but you need to explain the second source slightly more fully. The long description of the weather is superfluous: it does not help answer this question. Keep the date and the detail about the stall.
Please bring the revised draft next week. Lin: I expected a mark straight away. This is more useful.
Tutor: Feedback gives you something to work on. You have made progress since the first outline.
Lin: It took determination to start again after so long.
Tutor: I can see that. The change in this paragraph is astonishing: last week it had three unsupported claims, and now you show where each detail comes from. Lin read the note once more at the library window. She deleted the weather description and moved the date into the first sentence. The margin had enough space for the explanation she still needed to write. She would finish that part before the next meeting, then bring the page back to the same desk.

readingBlocks.en: On Friday, Lin took her draft to the tutor's desk. There were only two pages, but she had read them so often that she no longer noticed their gaps. The tutor began with the assessment criteria: a clear question, relevant evidence and an explanation of how the evidence supported the answer. He put the criteria beside the draft rather than hiding them until the end.
readingBlocks.zh: 周五，林把草稿拿到导师桌前。只有两页，她却读了太多次，已经看不见其中的缺口。导师先拿出评估标准：清楚的问题、相关证据，以及证据如何支持答案的解释。他把标准放在草稿旁，而不是等到最后才给她看。

readingBlocks.en:
Feedback on your draft
The question is clear. Your assessment of the photograph is careful, but you need to explain the second source slightly more fully. The long description of the weather is superfluous: it does not help answer this question. Keep the date and the detail about the stall.
Please bring the revised draft next week.
readingBlocks.zh:
草稿反馈
问题清楚。你对照片作了细致评估，不过第二个来源需要解释得稍微充分一些。那段很长的天气描述是多余的，它不能帮助回答这个问题。保留日期和摊位细节。
下周请带来修改后的草稿。
readingBlocks.title: The tutor’s note

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: I expected a mark straight away. This is more useful.
Tutor: Feedback gives you something to work on. You have made progress since the first outline.
Lin: It took determination to start again after so long.
Tutor: I can see that. The change in this paragraph is astonishing: last week it had three unsupported claims, and now you show where each detail comes from.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：我以为马上会得到一个分数。这种反馈更有用。
导师：反馈给你一个可以着手改的地方。与最初的提纲相比，你已经取得进步。
林：隔了这么久重新开始，确实需要决心。
导师：看得出来。这一段的变化真令人惊讶：上周有三条没有依据的说法，现在你说明了每个细节从哪里来。

readingBlocks.en: Lin read the note once more at the library window. She deleted the weather description and moved the date into the first sentence. The margin had enough space for the explanation she still needed to write. She would finish that part before the next meeting, then bring the page back to the same desk.
readingBlocks.zh: 林在图书馆窗边又读了一遍便条。她删去天气描述，把日期移入第一句。页边还留着足够位置，可以补上仍需写的解释。她会在下一次会面前完成那部分，再把稿纸带回这张桌子。

glossary.zh: 判断或评估所用的标准
glossary.note: criterion为单数，criteria为复数；assessment criteria表示评估标准。
glossary.example: The assessment criteria include a clear question and relevant evidence.
glossary.exampleZh: 评估标准包括清楚的问题和相关证据。

externalEvidence.definition: a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated

glossary.zh: 经过考虑作出的评估或判断
glossary.note: 名词，assessment of + 对象，表示对某事作出的评估或判断。
glossary.example: Lin’s assessment of the photograph is careful.
glossary.exampleZh: 林对照片的评估很细致。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · assessment
externalEvidence.findingZh: 对对象经过仔细思考形成的意见或判断；不是自动等同学生测试。

glossary.zh: 关于表现或作品的意见反馈
glossary.note: 不可数名词，feedback on + 作品；建议、评价或信息，而非自动等同于分数。
glossary.example: The tutor gives Lin feedback on her draft.
glossary.exampleZh: 导师就林的草稿给出反馈。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · feedback
externalEvidence.findingZh: 对作品或表现质量的建议、评价或信息；不可数，feedback on。

glossary.note: 副词修饰程度，slightly more + 形容词或副词。
glossary.example: Explain the second source slightly more fully.
glossary.exampleZh: 把第二个来源解释得稍微充分一些。

externalEvidence.definition: to a small degree or extent

glossary.note: 较正式，表示对当前目的不需要；不是说天气在所有文章里都无关。
glossary.example: The long weather description is superfluous in this essay.
glossary.exampleZh: 在这篇文章里，长段天气描述是多余的。

externalEvidence.definition: more than is needed, desired, or required

glossary.zh: 朝目标取得的进展或进步
glossary.note: 不可数名词，make progress；这里不是进行中的动词progress。
glossary.example: Lin has made progress since the first outline.
glossary.exampleZh: 与第一份提纲相比，林已取得进步。

externalEvidence.definition: gradual improvement or growth or development

glossary.note: 名词表达坚定意志；与测定、确定结果等义分开。
glossary.example: It took determination to return to study.
glossary.exampleZh: 重新回到学习中需要决心。

externalEvidence.definition: the quality of being determined to do or achieve something; firmness of purpose

glossary.note: 形容事情令人惊讶；人的感受一般用astonished。
glossary.example: The change in her paragraph is astonishing.
glossary.exampleZh: 她这一段的变化非常令人惊讶。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a classmate how the draft will be judged and what kind of judgement the teacher has made about the photograph.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉同学草稿如何评判，以及老师对照片分析作了什么判断。
acceptableAnswers: The criteria include a clear question and relevant evidence. The teacher says my assessment of the photograph is careful.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Summarise the teacher’s advice about the second source and the weather description.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 概述老师对第二个来源及天气描述的建议。
acceptableAnswers: The feedback asks me to explain the source slightly more fully and remove the superfluous weather description.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Describe what has changed since the first outline and what it took to begin again.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 描述与第一份提纲相比有哪些变化，以及重新开始需要什么。
acceptableAnswers: I have made progress. Returning to study took determination, and the change in this paragraph is astonishing.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: A colleague asks for comments on a short report. Give one clear suggestion and say which detail does not help its purpose.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 同事请你点评一份短报告。给一条清楚的建议，并说哪项细节对报告目的没帮助。
acceptableAnswers: My feedback is to explain the source slightly more fully. This extra description is superfluous.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
